# Billing / x402 / wallet

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- BILLING_FAILOVER_ENABLED — default: **ON** — Attempt provider fallback on a billing/quota/402 error before permanent halt.
- CREDIT_SENTINEL_ENABLED — default: **ON** — §6.3 provider-credit sentinel: a credit-death refusal (402/insufficient_quota/billing) from an autonomous goal/cron run sends ONE safety-net notice via the delivery rail and pauses goal dispatch + LLM cron ticks via a durable latch file (`…
- CREDIT_SENTINEL_RELEASE_HOURS — default: 6 — Auto-release window for the credit sentinel — after this many hours the latch expires and one paid probe may run (re-tripping if credits are still dead).
- LLM_OUTAGE_NOTICE — default: **ON** — When an owner-facing chat-surface turn dies with ALL LLM providers exhausted (e.g. the 2026-07-16 OpenRouter 402 cascade), send ONE static, LLM-independent ⚠️ notice back over the originating surface instead of total silence.
- X402_ENABLED — default: OFF ('false') — Enable x402 pay-per-request *receiving*.
- X402_CLIENT_ENABLED — default: OFF ('false') — Enable the agent-side x402 *paying* tool.
- X402_PAYMENT_RECIPIENT — default: '' — Treasury/recipient address for x402 receipts.
- X402_TREASURY_FROM_WALLET — default: **ON** — when `X402_PAYMENT_RECIPIENT` is empty and the agent wallet is enabled, the wallet's treasury-venue address is used as the x402 receive address — read from memory at call time, never written to any env file.
- X402_INVOICE_MAX_USD — default: 50 — Hard ceiling on a single agent-created payment request (an absurd invoice is a reputation incident).
- FAIL_ON_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS — default: ON — Billing enforcement mode of the usage tracker: ON = an LLM call that would overdraw the tenant's credits raises `InsufficientCreditsError` and stops the run (fail-fast billing); OFF = the call is recorded but not blocked (dev/reconciliatio…
- X402_INVOICE_DAILY_MAX — default: 10 — Max invoices one tenant may create per trailing 24h.
- X402_PUBLIC_RATE_PER_WINDOW — default: 20 — Per-IP call budget for the PUBLIC (anon-allowed, enumerable `inv_<12hex>` id) invoice endpoints — `GET /api/x402/requests/{id}` and `POST /api/x402/requests/{id}/pay`.
- X402_PUBLIC_RATE_WINDOW_SEC — default: 60 — Window (seconds) for `X402_PUBLIC_RATE_PER_WINDOW`.
- X402_TRUSTED_PROXIES — default: '' (loopback 127.0.0.1/::1 always trusted) — ⚠️ **Security fix (regression, reproduced live):** the public invoice rate limiter above was keyed on `get_client_ip`, which returns a client-supplied `X-Forwarded-For` VERBATIM — spoofable, letting an attacker either evade the cap (rotate…
- USAGE_INVOICE_BRIDGE_ENABLED — default: OFF — the metering→invoice bridge: registers the read-only `usage_summary` agent action (tenant-scoped LLM usage rollup — api_cost_usd/credits/calls, optionally narrowed to a `session_id`/`since` — plus a non-binding `suggested_invoice` draft).
- USAGE_INVOICE_MARKUP — default: 1.0 — Multiplier applied to a rollup's `api_cost_usd` when `build_invoice_draft` proposes a `suggested_invoice` amount (`1.0` = passthrough, no markup).
- INVOICE_QR_STYLE — default: address — What the invoice card's QR code encodes (via `modules/x402/artifact.py::build_payment_artifact`): `address` — the bare treasury address string (works with any wallet's "scan an address" import); `eip681` — an EIP-681 USDC transfer URI (`et…
- X402_SETTLEMENT_WATCH_INTERVAL_SEC — default: 60 — Settlement-watcher tick interval (expire stale invoices; wake the originating session via self-wake when one settles; emits `payment_settled`/`payment_expired`).
- X402_INVOICE_AMOUNT_JITTER — default: **ON** — Amount jitter for on-chain matching: `create_payment_request` adds a RANDOM sub-cent tail to every new EVM invoice amount (so $5.00 becomes e.g. $5.003721 — not only on a collision), then, when an equal-amount PENDING invoice already exist…
- X402_SETTLEMENT_SCAN_MAX_SPAN — default: 5000 — Max blocks one settlement-watcher tick will scan for on-chain detection, even after a long gap (bounds a single `eth_getLogs` call).
- X402_SETTLEMENT_CONFIRMATIONS — default: unset (per-chain depth) — Confirmations buffer for on-chain detection — blocks within this many of the chain head are never scanned yet (a just-mined block can still reorg out).
- X402_SETTLEMENT_RPC — default: '' — watcher-specific RPC pin for on-chain detection of the `X402_DEFAULT_CHAIN` ONLY — one URL serves one chain, so an invoice on any other chain is scanned on that chain's own pinned RPC.
- PAYMENT_DEFAULT_ASSET — default: '' (⇒ the chain's canonical USDC) — instance-wide default `asset_id` for a new invoice when the caller names none.
- PAYMENT_QUOTE_MAX_AGE_SEC — default: 300 — max age of a price quote used to size a USD-denominated invoice in a NON-stable asset.
- ROOM_ACTIONS_ENABLED — default: OFF — paid moderation actions in a group room.
- ROOM_ACTION_OFFER_TTL — default: 30m — fallback deadline for an UNPAID paid-action offer, for a room that set no `chat.paid_offer_ttl`.
- ROOM_ACTION_CARD_ENABLED — default: ⇒ ROOM_ACTIONS_ENABLED — render a payment card (QR) alongside a paid-action offer and deliver it in the room.
- SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED — default: OFF — the first revenue wedge: watchtower subscriptions — a prepaid-period + renewal-invoice model gating a cron job's continued firing.
- WATCHTOWER_PRICE_USD — default: 10.00 — Default monthly price (USD) for a watchtower subscription — `create_subscription` falls back to this when no explicit `amount_usd` is given.
- SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWAL_LEAD_DAYS — default: 5 — Days before a subscription's `paid_through` the settlement watcher creates the next renewal invoice.
- SUBSCRIPTION_GRACE_DAYS — default: 3 — Days past `paid_through` a lapsed subscription keeps its cron job running (status `grace`, still chasing renewal) before it is `suspended` (cron job $0-skips).
- X402_DEFAULT_CHAIN — default: base — Default chain for x402.
- X402_FACILITATOR_URL — default: '' — x402 facilitator endpoint.

- X402_MAX_TOKENS_PER_REQUEST — default: 200000 — Token budget one x402 request prepays for. **SSOT for BOTH the derived price AND the runtime hard cap** — `LLMUsageTracker` halts an x402 request (`InsufficientCreditsError`) once its per-session cumulative tokens exceed this, so actual co…
- X402_PRICE_MARKUP — default: 2.0 — Safety multiplier on the derived x402 price (margin over worst-case token cost).
- AGENT_WALLET_ENABLED — default: OFF — Enable the agent's native wallet.
- AGENT_WALLET_MASTER_SEED — default: unset — **SECRET, masked** — The agent wallet's master seed (hex, ≥32 chars); every wallet key derives from it. `polyrob wallet init` writes it to `~/.polyrob/.env`; `polyrob doctor`/`wallet` verbs read it to check wallet health.
- AGENT_WALLET_NETWORK — default: testnet — Wallet network (`testnet`/`mainnet`).
- AGENT_WALLET_BACKEND — default: local_eoa — Wallet key backend.
- AGENT_WALLET_MAX_PER_TX_USD — default: 250 — Per-transaction USD ceiling (catastrophic-loss guard, NOT a budget).
- AGENT_WALLET_OPERATIONAL_VENUE — default: treasury — Venue key that same-chain spend paths (x402, generic payments) SIGN with, so the funded address (`AgentWallet.address`) equals the spent-from address. "Venue" elsewhere stays a policy/accounting label; hyperliquid keeps its own delegated k…
- WALLET_SIGNER — default: local — where the agent's signatures come from. `local` = today: the agent process holds the seed and signs in process. `shadow` = it still signs locally AND asks `polyrob-signer` (its own UID, Unix socket `/run/polyrob-signer/signer.sock`, `SO_PE…
- AGENT_WALLET_DERIVATION — default: unset (meta.json wins; absent = legacy) — Recovery-hatch override for the wallet's key-derivation scheme (`legacy` | `bip44`).
- WALLET_DAILY_CAP_USD — default: 100 — Rolling 24h spend cap (2026-08-22: was unset/disabled — the per-tx ceiling alone cannot stop a within-ceiling loop draining the treasury one ticket at a time).
- CREDIT_VALUE_USD — default: 0.01 — USD value of one credit.
- WELCOME_BONUS — default: 0 — Optional new-wallet credit grant; default zero because wallet creation does not prove a unique person.

- EIP8004_ONCHAIN_ENABLED — default: OFF ('false') — **Operator ATTESTATION** that this agent is registered on an Identity Registry someone else transacted with: flips the publicly-served `/eip8004/registration.json` `trustMode` from `local` to `onchain`, and (only when `EIP8004_AGENT_ID`/`E…
- EIP8004_CHAIN_ID — default: 8453 (Base) — Chain id the ERC-8004 registries live on.
- EIP8004_IDENTITY_REGISTRY / EIP8004_REPUTATION_REGISTRY / EIP8004_VALIDATION_REGISTRY — default: unset — Contract addresses of the three ERC-8004 registries; unset = that registry is unconfigured (local/simulation mode).
- EIP8004_AGENT_ID — default: 0 (= none) — This agent's on-chain ERC-8004 agent id; `0`/unset = not registered.
- EIP8004_AGENT_WALLET — default: unset — The wallet address attested in the ERC-8004 registration (an address, not a key).

- CDP_API_KEY_ID / CDP_API_KEY_SECRET — default: unset (secret is masked) — Coinbase CDP credentials for the mainnet x402 facilitator (from portal.cdp.coinbase.com); testnet's x402.org facilitator needs neither.
- X402_PAYMENT_ADDRESS — default: unset — Legacy env spelling for the x402 receive address, kept as the LAST fallback after `resolve_treasury_address()` (explicit `X402_PAYMENT_RECIPIENT` > wallet treasury > this).

- PRICING_MARKUP — default: 1.00 — Multiplier on provider API cost for internal credit billing (`1.20` = +20%).
- MIN_CREDIT_CHARGE — default: 1 — Minimum credits charged per LLM call (prevents free calls).
- SESSION_CREATION_COST — default: 1 — Credits charged for creating a session.
- VISION_CALL_COST — default: 2 — Credits charged per vision call.
- TOOL_CALL_COST — default: 0.5 — Credits charged per tool call.
- ETH_PRICE_USD_OVERRIDE — default: unset — Fixed ETH/USD price for the deposit monitor — bypasses the live CoinGecko fetch entirely.
- ETH_PRICE_USD_MAX — default: 50000 — Sanity upper bound on the ETH/USD price (override or live fetch); a price above this raises instead of crediting a wildly-inflated deposit — guards against an oracle schema error or an `ETH_PRICE_USD_OVERRIDE` typo.

- SWEEP_INTERVAL — default: 3600 (1h) — Poll interval (seconds) between `TreasurySweeper` sweep passes, once enabled.

- ENABLE_CREDIT_SYSTEM — default: ON (True) — Start the credit balance manager (credit tracking and metering) at server start.
- BYPASS_PAYMENT_FOR_ADMINS — default: ON (True) — ⚠️ An admin-role caller, and the operator service token (`API_AUTH_TOKEN`), skip payment verification on paid API routes (no x402, no credit debit). `false` makes both pay like any user.
- PAYMENT_MASTER_SEED — default: unset — Master seed for deterministic per-user deposit-address derivation. `resolve_master_seed()` is the SSOT: unset ⇒ deposit-address generation disabled, logged as a warning, not a crash.
